def fit(cols,names):
    X=np.c_[cols]
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X.T,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    res=np.mean((X.T@c-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    print(names, np.round(c,4), res)
